messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-embed-service (eu-west-1)
incident-bot: alert_id=PD-48291 severity=high threshold=errors>5% in last 5m
pagerbot: Auto-claim attempt: assigning to current on-call Jordan H
Jordan H: acked. I'm taking ownership. joining bridge now — https://meet.redwood/incident/48291 :eyes:
Anna S: thx. customer impact? saw increased 5xx in EU embeddings
Jordan H: confirmed. embeddings pods returning 503s; affects 2 customer orgs in EU. no tokenization errors in logs.
Mike L: @Jordan H can you check if autoscaler didn't kick? Last metric spike looks like CPU throttling on the embedding workers.
Jordan H: on it. checking HPA + pods
Jordan H: ```kubectl get hpa -n inference
NAME          REFERENCE                  TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
embed-hpa     Deployment/embed-workers    80%/90%   3         10        3
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embed
embed-0       1/1 Running   3m
embed-1       0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  2m
embed-2       1/1 Running   4m
``` 
Jordan H: hpa not scaling because CPU usage < target; pods crashing because OOM from batch size spike. I can manually restart and scale.
Lucy R: If we scale too fast, be mindful of GPU memory. We can reduce concurrency config first.
Jordan H: rolling restart embed-1 and lowering concurrency config
Jordan H: ```kubectl set env deployment/embed-workers -n inference WORKER_CONCURRENCY=8
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-workers -n inference
``` 
sre-automation: Action logged: manual-scale by Jordan H; set WORKER_CONCURRENCY=8; rollout initiated
Anna S: customer comms: reached out to support slack for affected customers, will send ETA once stable
Mike L: monitoring: adding a short-term rate limiter rule at the ingress to cap per-customer rps to 30 until stable
Jordan H: pods coming up. embed-1 restarted and now 1/1 Running. latency trending back to normal. errors dropping to 0.8%
Jordan H: moving to postmortem mode. tagging @oncall-next (Lucy R) for handoff in 10m if anything reappears
Lucy R: I'll take follow-up for the quiet window. thanks for triage @Jordan H — please add the logs to the incident ticket.
Jordan H: will attach logs + runbook steps. marking as resolved for now. closing bridge in 5.
pagerbot: PagerDuty note: alert PD-48291 acknowledged by Jordan H; status=resolved (auto after manual close)
incident-bot: Incident summary: root cause suspected batch-size spike causing OOM in embed-workers; mitigation applied: reduced concurrency + restart; customer impact limited to 2 EU orgs; follow-up: add autoscale rules for memory and add per-customer rate limit; owner for follow-up=Lucy R
Jordan H: thanks team :thumbsup:
